title: Mipo and the Missing Rainbow Color
audience: Children 2-7 (works up to ~9). English narration, simple words, calm pace, interactive pauses.
missing_color_note: The missing color is PURPLE. It appears nowhere on Mipo. Until the wand tap in 'The tap: MAGIC!' the rainbow has no purple stripe, purple things (castle roofs, crystals, purple flowers) are soft grey and the world is slightly muted. Afterwards purple is restored everywhere.
storyboard_reference: None yet (the 30 s Shorts animatic covers the core beats).
learning_goals: Rainbow colors: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple
Naming feelings: sad, scared, brave, happy
Asking for help, helping others, taking turns
emotional_arc: sad -> calmer -> hopeful -> brave -> caring -> brave together -> kind -> joyful

voice.character: narrator (gentle storyteller) + Mipo + Blue Bird + Bunny + Baby Deer + Little Purple
voice.description: Narrator: warm, friendly storyteller. Mipo: warm, cheerful young boy (6-7). Friends: small, sweet, distinct. Clear American English, calm pace with pauses for kids to answer.
voice.consistency: Each character always uses the same ElevenLabs voice (production/voices.json). Never change a character's voice between episodes.

end_card.subtitle: Mipo's Magical World
end_card.note: Draw in the editor; the last 20 s also leave room for YouTube end-screen elements.

sequences.title: Cold open: the rainbow has a gap
sequences.learning: Hook: there is a problem to solve together
sequences.music: Bright music-box sting, then soft curious pad
sequences.location: Rainbow Hill above the magical valley

shots.name: Valley flyover to Mipo
shots.camera: Slow aerial glide over the colorful valley down to Mipo on a grassy hill.
shots.start_frame: Wide 3D view of a bright magical valley at morning: giant tree with a cozy treehouse and glowing lanterns, floating island castle with soft grey cone roofs and a waterfall, stone arch bridge over a sparkling river, a rainbow with red, orange, yellow, green and blue stripes and an empty gap where the purple stripe should be. Mipo stands small on a grassy hill, waving.
shots.motion: Camera glides down over the valley to Mipo, who waves happily at the viewer, then looks up at the rainbow and tilts his head.
shots.end_frame: Medium shot of Mipo waving at camera under the rainbow with the empty purple gap.
sfx: soft magical sparkle chime, gentle twinkles, children's cartoon, no voice
gentle curious two-note music box 'uh-oh', soft, not sad
shots.camera_motion: slow aerial glide down to Mipo

shots.name: Will you help me?
shots.camera: Medium close-up, Mipo talks to camera; gentle push-in.
shots.start_frame: Mipo on the hill pointing up at the gap in the rainbow, looking at the viewer with hopeful eyes, star wand glowing in his left hand.
shots.motion: Mipo points at the missing stripe, then turns to the camera with a hopeful smile and holds out his right hand as if inviting the viewer along. Sparkles drift.
shots.end_frame: Mipo smiling at camera, hand held out, sparkles around him.
lines: One color is missing! Will you help me find it?
hopeful, inviting, a tiny pause before 'find it'
sfx: happy little cartoon whoosh with sparkles

sequences.title: Theme song montage
sequences.music: THEME SONG (original): 'Mipo, Mipo, wave your wand, / colors shining all day long! / Friends and fun and magic too, / Mipo's world is here for you!' Upbeat, 112 BPM, ukulele + glockenspiel + claps; end on a sparkle.

shots.name: Theme: running with friends
shots.camera: Tracking shot alongside Mipo running through flowers.
shots.start_frame: Mipo runs happily through a colorful flower meadow with the blue bird flying beside him, the white bunny hopping and the baby deer trotting, all smiling.
shots.motion: Joyful slow-motion run through the flowers, petals and sparkles float up, friends play around Mipo.
sfx: light whoosh of running through grass with sparkles

shots.name: Theme: wand sparkle spin
shots.camera: Low-angle hero shot, slow orbit around Mipo.
shots.start_frame: Mipo on a mossy rock under a bright sky spins his glowing star wand; a ribbon of golden sparkles swirls around him.
shots.motion: Mipo twirls the wand in a circle and a sparkle ribbon spirals into the sky and bursts softly into tiny stars.

shots.name: Theme: logo moment
shots.camera: Static wide sky shot with space in the center for the logo (added in the editor).
shots.start_frame: Bright blue sky with fluffy clouds and floating golden sparkles, clean empty center area for a title logo, no text.
shots.motion: Sparkles twinkle and clouds drift slowly; a soft burst of light in the center.

sequences.title: Morning: the missing purple
sequences.learning: Naming feelings; it's okay to feel sad; belly breathing
sequences.music: Soft, slow celesta and warm strings; gentle minor color while Mipo is sad (never scary); calm breathing pad
sequences.location: Cozy pastel treehouse bedroom, then the treehouse porch

shots.name: Wake up
shots.start_frame: Cozy pastel treehouse bedroom at sunrise, warm wooden walls, glowing lantern, round window. Mipo sits up in a small wooden bed under a teal star blanket, eyes closed, sleepy. His star wand lies glowing on the bedside table.
shots.motion: Golden sunbeams with dust sparkles move across Mipo; he slowly opens his eyes and blinks sleepily.
shots.end_frame: Mipo awake, sleepy smile, sunbeam on his face.
lines: Good morning, Mipo! The sun is up, and the birds are singing.
sfx: distant cheerful morning songbirds outside a window, calm

shots.name: Big stretch
shots.start_frame: Mipo sitting up in bed, arms starting to rise, sunbeams, wand glowing on the bedside table.
shots.motion: Mipo stretches both arms up high with a big cute yawn, then smiles.

shots.name: The window: purple is gone
shots.camera: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Mipo to the round window, then reverse close-up of his face.
shots.start_frame: Mipo kneels at the big round window looking out at the rainbow, which has no purple stripe; the purple flowers below are grey.
shots.motion: Mipo's happy face slowly changes to surprise as he notices the gap; he presses his hands to the window glass.
shots.end_frame: Close-up of Mipo surprised, mouth in a small 'o'.
lines: Oh no... where is the purple?
The purple stripe is gone. And look... the purple flowers are grey.
sfx: gentle descending three-note music box, curious not scary

shots.name: Sad on the porch
shots.camera: Wide, then slow push to medium.
shots.start_frame: Treehouse porch with wooden railing overlooking the slightly muted valley. Mipo sits on the top step, chin in his hands, looking down; a grey flower in a pot beside him.
shots.motion: Mipo sighs and his shoulders drop; a leaf drifts past. Calm, soft lighting, nothing scary.
shots.end_frame: Mipo looking sad, small and gentle.
lines: Mipo feels sad. That's okay. Everybody feels sad sometimes.

shots.name: Belly breathing
shots.camera: Medium shot facing Mipo, calm and still.
shots.start_frame: Mipo sitting on the porch step, eyes closed, one hand on his tummy, soft morning light.
shots.motion: Mipo breathes in slowly (shoulders rise, cheeks puff a little), then breathes out slowly; repeats once. Tiny sparkles drift on the breath.
shots.end_frame: Mipo calmer, a small smile appearing.
lines: Let's take a big breath with Mipo. Smell the flower...
...and blow out the candle. One more time!
slow, calm, playful at the end

shots.name: A little better
shots.start_frame: Close-up of Mipo on the porch opening his eyes with a small brave smile.
shots.motion: Mipo opens his eyes and smiles a little; the light gets warmer.
lines: I feel a little better now.

shots.name: Blue Bird comforts Mipo
shots.camera: Two-shot, Mipo and the bird on the railing.
shots.start_frame: The round blue bird lands on the porch railing next to Mipo, chirping softly; Mipo looks up at it.
shots.motion: The bird hops closer and gently pats Mipo's shoulder with its wing; Mipo smiles more.
shots.end_frame: Mipo and the bird smiling at each other.
lines: Hello, Blue Bird. The rainbow lost its purple.
Tweet! Don't worry, Mipo. We can find it together!
sfx: soft bird wing flutter landing and a happy little tweet

sequences.title: The wand shows the way
sequences.learning: Courage: trying even when it's hard
sequences.music: Rising, hopeful theme; music box + light strings, gentle build
sequences.location: Treehouse porch and path down into the valley

shots.name: The wand glows and flies
shots.camera: Inside-to-outside move: from the bedside table through the window to the porch.
shots.start_frame: Inside the bedroom, the star wand on the bedside table starts to glow brightly; through the window Mipo is visible on the porch.
shots.motion: The wand lifts up, floats out of the window with a sparkle trail and lands gently in Mipo's LEFT hand on the porch.
shots.end_frame: Mipo holding the glowing wand, amazed.
lines: Look! Mipo's magic wand is glowing!
sfx: magical shimmering hum of a glowing wand
light magical whoosh with sparkles as a wand flies

shots.name: A sparkle trail
shots.camera: Medium shot, then pan to the trail leading into the valley.
shots.start_frame: Mipo raises the glowing wand; tiny golden and lilac sparkles appear in the air in front of the porch.
shots.motion: The sparkles line up into a twinkling trail that winds down the treehouse path toward a red garden in the valley.
shots.end_frame: The sparkle trail leading into the valley.
lines: A sparkle trail! It will show us the way!
sfx: series of tiny twinkling sparkle sounds appearing one by one

shots.name: I'll bring it back
shots.start_frame: Mipo tightens his backpack straps on the porch, the wand in his left hand, red scarf fluttering, the rainbow with the gap behind him.
shots.motion: Mipo nods with determination, looks up at the rainbow and smiles bravely.
lines: Don't worry, rainbow. I'll bring your purple back!

shots.name: Down the treehouse path
shots.camera: Tracking shot following Mipo and the bird down a winding wooden path.
shots.start_frame: Mipo walks down the wooden stairs of the treehouse path following the sparkle trail; the blue bird flies beside him.
shots.motion: Mipo skips down the steps, the bird loops happily, the sparkles twinkle ahead.
lines: Are you ready, friends? Let's follow the sparkles!
sfx: light child footsteps on wooden steps, cheerful

shots.name: Through the valley
shots.start_frame: Wide shot of the slightly muted valley: Mipo and the blue bird walking along a flower path toward a garden full of red, the sparkle trail ahead; some flowers are soft grey.
shots.motion: Mipo and the bird travel along the path; the sparkle trail glides ahead.
sfx: gentle nature ambience with soft birdsong

sequences.title: Red Strawberry Garden
sequences.learning: Color RED; counting 1-5; making a new friend
sequences.music: Bouncy pizzicato strings and marimba, playful

shots.name: Welcome to the red garden
shots.start_frame: A cheerful garden where everything is red: giant shiny strawberries, red tulips, red poppies, a little red watering can. Mipo and the blue bird arrive at the gate.
shots.motion: Mipo looks around with wonder; a red ladybug flies past.
lines: Welcome to the Red Strawberry Garden! Everything here is... red!
inviting the viewer, pause for kids, then cheerful

shots.name: Bunny peeks out
shots.camera: Medium shot of a strawberry patch.
shots.start_frame: The fluffy white bunny peeks out from behind big green strawberry leaves, holding a red strawberry, cheeks full.
shots.motion: The bunny pops up, wiggles its nose and waves shyly at Mipo; Mipo waves back.
lines: Hi, Mipo! Do you want to help me pick strawberries?
sfx: soft cute cartoon pop as the bunny appears

shots.name: Counting strawberries
shots.camera: Top-down then side shot of a little basket.
shots.start_frame: Mipo and the bunny kneel by a small wicker basket in the strawberry patch.
shots.motion: One by one they place five big red strawberries into the basket; each one lands with a tiny bounce and sparkle.
lines: Let's count them together! One... two... three... four... five!
slow counting, one number per second, joyful

shots.name: Asking about purple
shots.start_frame: Mipo and the bunny sitting by the full basket, the bunny holding a strawberry happily.
shots.motion: The bunny says thank you and nibbles; Mipo asks his question with a kind, hopeful face.
lines: Five yummy strawberries! Thank you, Mipo.
Bunny, have you seen the purple from the rainbow?

shots.name: The bunny remembers
shots.camera: Close-up on the bunny, then whip-pan to a distant orange hill.
shots.start_frame: The bunny taps its chin, thinking; behind them, far away, an orange hill full of pumpkins.
shots.motion: The bunny's ears perk up and it points toward the orange hill.
lines: Hmm... I saw purple sparkles hopping over Pumpkin Hill!

shots.name: A new friend joins
shots.start_frame: Mipo holds out his right hand to the bunny; the blue bird hovers above.
shots.motion: The bunny hops happily into place next to Mipo; all three cheer softly.
lines: Now Mipo has two friends. Friends make adventures more fun!

shots.name: Off to Pumpkin Hill
shots.start_frame: Mipo, the bunny and the bird walk out of the red garden along a path toward an orange hill, sparkle trail ahead.
shots.motion: They walk and hop together; the bunny bounces playfully.
sfx: playful hopping and footsteps on a dirt path

sequences.title: Orange Pumpkin Hill
sequences.learning: Color ORANGE; helping a friend who falls

shots.name: Pumpkin Hill
shots.start_frame: A sunny hill covered in round orange pumpkins, orange autumn leaves and orange flowers; Mipo, the bunny and the bird at the bottom.
shots.motion: Orange leaves twirl in a gentle breeze; Mipo looks up the hill.
lines: This is Pumpkin Hill. What color are the pumpkins?
sfx: soft rustling autumn leaves in a gentle breeze

shots.name: Bunny slips
shots.camera: Medium shot on a gentle slope.
shots.start_frame: Mipo and the bunny climbing a gentle grassy slope between pumpkins.
shots.motion: The bunny's paw slips on a leaf and it slides down softly and sits, a little sad (no injury). Mipo turns around with concern.
shots.end_frame: Bunny sitting, a little sad; Mipo coming to help.
lines: Are you okay, Bunny? Take my hand.
sfx: soft cartoon slide whoop on grass, gentle and funny, not scary

shots.name: Helping hand
shots.start_frame: Mipo reaches out his right hand to the sitting bunny.
shots.motion: The bunny takes Mipo's hand and stands up, smiling again; they hug briefly.
lines: Thank you, Mipo! You are a good friend.
Helping a friend feels warm and happy inside.

shots.name: Roll, pumpkin, roll!
shots.camera: Wide side shot of the slope.
shots.start_frame: A small round pumpkin at the top of a gentle grassy slope; Mipo and the bunny watch.
shots.motion: The little pumpkin rolls slowly down the slope with a happy bounce and stops in a pile of soft leaves; everyone laughs.
sfx: gentle cartoon rolling pumpkin with soft boing at the end

shots.name: A purple sparkle!
shots.camera: Close-up on a leaf, then rack focus to Mipo.
shots.start_frame: At the top of the hill a single tiny purple sparkle rests on an orange leaf; Mipo leans close to look.
shots.motion: The purple sparkle lifts off and floats away toward a field of tall yellow sunflowers; Mipo points.
lines: Look! A purple sparkle! It went that way!
sfx: delicate high purple twinkle floating away

shots.name: Down to the sunflowers
shots.start_frame: Mipo, the bunny and the bird walk happily down the far side of the hill toward a field of giant sunflowers.
shots.motion: They walk down together; the sparkle trail glows ahead.
sfx: light footsteps and hops on grass

sequences.title: Yellow Sunflower Meadow
sequences.learning: Color YELLOW; asking for help; taking turns
sequences.music: Sunny ukulele + glockenspiel, light and bouncy

shots.name: Yellow like the sun
shots.start_frame: A meadow of tall bright yellow sunflowers and yellow butterflies under a warm sun; Mipo and friends at the edge.
shots.motion: Yellow butterflies flutter around Mipo; he spins happily.
lines: Can you find something yellow where you are?
inviting the viewer; leave a pause after
sfx: light fluttering butterfly wings and soft chimes

shots.name: Too tall!
shots.camera: Low angle looking up past Mipo at the giant sunflowers.
shots.start_frame: Mipo stands among sunflowers much taller than him, standing on tiptoe, trying to see over them.
shots.motion: Mipo hops up and down to see; the sunflowers sway; he can't see over.
lines: Hmm... the sunflowers are so tall. I can't see the sparkles!

shots.name: Baby Deer appears
shots.start_frame: The sunflowers part and the spotted baby deer steps out gently, smiling at Mipo.
shots.motion: The deer lowers its head politely and smiles; Mipo waves hello.
lines: Hello! I'm tall. Maybe I can help!

shots.name: The deer looks
shots.camera: Over-the-shoulder from behind the deer looking over the sunflowers.
shots.start_frame: The baby deer stretches its neck to look over the sunflowers; far away, the sparkle trail enters a green forest.
shots.motion: The deer's ears perk up and it turns back to Mipo happily.
lines: I see the sparkles! They are going into the Green Forest.

shots.name: Taking turns
shots.start_frame: Mipo and the baby deer face each other among the sunflowers; the bunny and bird nearby.
shots.motion: Mipo thanks the deer; the deer bows; they agree to take turns leading, the deer lets the bunny go first.
lines: Thank you, Deer! Will you come too?
Yes! Let's take turns leading the way.
Taking turns is a kind thing to do.

shots.name: Four friends together
shots.start_frame: Mipo, the bunny, the baby deer and the blue bird walk in a happy line through the sunflowers toward a green forest.
shots.motion: They walk together in a line, taking turns at the front.
sfx: light group footsteps on grass, birdsong

sequences.title: Green Whispering Forest
sequences.learning: Color GREEN; being brave with friends
sequences.music: Soft woodwinds and harp, a little mysterious but warm; brightens when fireflies appear

shots.name: Into the green forest
shots.start_frame: A friendly forest of tall trees, green leaves, soft green moss and ferns, gentle light beams; the four friends at the entrance.
shots.motion: Leaves rustle gently; the friends look up in wonder.
lines: This is the Whispering Forest. Green leaves, green moss... green everywhere!
sfx: gentle forest ambience, soft leaves whispering, birds

shots.name: A little scared
shots.start_frame: Inside the forest it is a bit shady (still friendly, soft light). Mipo hugs his wand, looking around.
shots.motion: Mipo looks around a bit nervously; a leaf falls; he takes a small breath.
lines: It's a little dark in here... I feel a bit scared.
When we feel scared, we can hold a friend's hand.
shots.negative_extra: dark, scary, monsters, shadows with faces

shots.name: Holding hands
shots.start_frame: The bunny takes Mipo's right hand; the deer stands close; the bird lands on Mipo's backpack.
shots.motion: Mipo smiles and stands taller; the friends huddle close and smile.

shots.name: Fireflies light the way
shots.camera: Slow crane up through glowing fireflies.
shots.start_frame: Hundreds of friendly green-gold fireflies appear between the trees; Mipo's wand glows back at them.
shots.motion: The fireflies form a glowing path along the sparkle trail; everyone gasps happily.
lines: Look! The fireflies are lighting the way!

shots.name: Echo game
shots.camera: Medium shot of Mipo calling into a clearing.
shots.start_frame: Mipo stands in a mossy clearing, cupping his hands around his mouth.
shots.motion: Mipo calls out, the forest echoes softly, the friends giggle and call too.
lines: ...hellooo... Can you say hello with Mipo? Hellooo!
the first word soft like an echo, then inviting the viewer
sfx: soft friendly forest echo reverb tail

shots.name: A frog's clue
shots.camera: Close-up on a lily pad by a forest pond.
shots.start_frame: A small cute green frog on a lily pad by a little forest pond; the blue bird listens to it.
shots.motion: The frog croaks and points toward the light at the forest's edge; the bird flaps happily and turns to Mipo.
lines: Tweet! The frog says a little purple drop went to the river!

shots.name: Out of the forest
shots.start_frame: The friends walk toward the bright edge of the forest where blue water sparkles.
shots.motion: They step out of the trees into bright sunshine, smiling.

sequences.title: Blue Sparkle River
sequences.music: Flowing harp arpeggios and flute, sparkling
sequences.location: Blue Sparkle River and the stone bridge

shots.name: The blue river
shots.start_frame: A sparkling blue river with a waterfall from the floating island castle (grey roofs), blue forget-me-not flowers on the banks; the friends at the water's edge.
shots.motion: Water sparkles and flows; a blue dragonfly zips by; Mipo smiles.
lines: Blue, blue... the river is blue!
And the sky is blue too!
sfx: gentle flowing river and distant waterfall

shots.name: Stepping stones
shots.camera: Side tracking shot across stepping stones.
shots.start_frame: Six round stepping stones across a shallow stream. Mipo hops carefully from stone to stone, the bunny following.
shots.motion: Mipo hops carefully onto each stone in turn, arms out for balance, smiling.
lines: Let's count the stones as we hop! One... two... three...

shots.name: Slow and careful
shots.start_frame: The baby deer steps carefully on the stones, the bird flying alongside, Mipo waiting on the far bank cheering.
shots.motion: The deer reaches the bank safely; everyone claps.
lines: Slow and careful. Good job, friends!

shots.name: The stone bridge
shots.camera: Side tracking shot across the arched stone bridge.
shots.start_frame: The four friends cross the arched stone bridge with warm wooden railings over the river.
shots.motion: They walk across the bridge; at the far end the sparkle trail disappears into a glittering cave in a rocky hill.
lines: The sparkles go into that cave!
sfx: light footsteps on a stone bridge

shots.name: Crystal cave entrance
shots.camera: Slow push toward the cave mouth.
shots.start_frame: A friendly cave entrance decorated with crystals that should be purple but look soft grey; gentle light inside.
shots.motion: The sparkle trail floats into the cave; the friends peek in.
sfx: soft hollow cave hum with water drips, friendly

shots.name: Into the cave
shots.start_frame: Inside a softly lit crystal cave with smooth paths, grey crystals glowing faintly, the friends walking in together.
shots.motion: They walk in slowly, looking around with wonder; Mipo's wand lights the way.
sfx: gentle cave ambience with soft crystal tinkles

sequences.title: Crystal Cave: finding Little Purple
sequences.learning: Everyone is important; kindness helps others feel better
sequences.music: Tender celesta and soft strings; warm swell when Little Purple smiles

shots.name: Grey crystals
shots.start_frame: A big cave room with many crystals that look soft grey and dull; Mipo touches one gently.
shots.motion: The crystal flickers faintly purple for a second, then turns grey again.
lines: The crystals here should be purple... but they are grey.

shots.name: Someone is crying
shots.start_frame: Mipo stops and puts a finger to his lips; the friends lean in to listen.
shots.motion: Mipo tilts his head, listening; a soft sniffle echoes gently.
sfx: tiny soft cute sniffle, gentle, not distressing

shots.name: Meet Little Purple
shots.start_frame: Behind a crystal hides Little Purple: a tiny glowing purple paint droplet with big sparkly eyes and a small sad face.
shots.motion: Little Purple peeks out shyly, glowing softly, then looks down.
lines: I'm the purple. I felt so small... I thought nobody would miss me.
tiny, soft, shy, a little sad

shots.name: We missed you!
shots.start_frame: Mipo kneels down to Little Purple's level, smiling kindly, holding out his right hand.
shots.motion: Little Purple floats a little closer to Mipo's hand.
lines: We missed you so much! The rainbow needs you!
Every color is important. And every friend is important too.

shots.name: Friends say so too
shots.start_frame: The bunny, the baby deer and the blue bird gather around Little Purple and Mipo, smiling warmly.
shots.motion: Each friend leans in kindly as they speak; Little Purple glows a little brighter with each kind word.

shots.name: Little Purple smiles
shots.start_frame: Little Purple glows brightly, big happy smile; the crystals around begin to glimmer faintly purple.
shots.motion: Little Purple does a happy little spin in the air; sparkles fall; the friends cheer.

shots.name: Out of the cave
shots.start_frame: Mipo walks out of the cave into the sunlight with Little Purple floating beside his shoulder and the friends behind.
shots.motion: They walk toward a big grassy hill under the rainbow with the gap.

sequences.title: Completing the rainbow
sequences.music: Building drum roll and strings into a big but gentle magical swell on the tap; joyful full orchestra after

shots.name: Rainbow Hill
shots.start_frame: Mipo and his friends climb to the top of a grassy hill right under the rainbow with the empty purple gap; Little Purple floats beside Mipo.
shots.motion: They reach the top and look up at the gap.
lines: Mipo and his friends climb to the top of Rainbow Hill.

shots.name: Ready?
shots.camera: Medium shot of Mipo and Little Purple, then Mipo turns to camera.
shots.start_frame: Mipo holds the star wand in his left hand next to Little Purple floating in the air.
shots.motion: Mipo smiles at Little Purple, then turns to the camera to invite the viewer.
lines: Friends at home, count with me!

shots.name: Countdown
shots.camera: Close-up on the glowing wand tip, then Mipo.
shots.start_frame: The star wand glows brighter and brighter.
shots.motion: The wand pulses with each number.
lines: big countdown, one number per second

shots.name: The tap: MAGIC!
shots.start_frame: Mipo gently touches Little Purple with the star tip of his wand.
shots.motion: A soft magical flash; Little Purple turns into a swirl of purple sparkles that rises into the sky.
lines: joyful, the big moment; land the word on the tap
sfx: bright magical bell tap followed by a soft upward sparkly whoosh, not loud
shots.continuity: During this shot purple is restored: the swirl leaves Little Purple and rises.

shots.name: Painting the stripe
shots.camera: Tilt up from the friends to the sky.
shots.start_frame: Purple sparkles swirl up from the hilltop toward the gap in the rainbow.
shots.motion: The sparkles paint the missing purple stripe into the rainbow from left to right; the stripe glows.
lines: Swish! The purple goes back into the rainbow!
sfx: shimmering sparkle sweep painting across the sky

shots.name: Purple everywhere
shots.camera: Wide sweeping shot over the valley.
shots.start_frame: The whole valley in full color: purple castle roofs, glowing purple crystals, purple flowers blooming everywhere, full rainbow.
shots.motion: Purple color spreads across the valley like a gentle wave: flowers bloom, castle roofs turn purple, crystals glow.

shots.name: Full rainbow
shots.start_frame: The complete rainbow with all six stripes shining over the valley; the friends tiny on the hilltop cheering.
shots.motion: The rainbow glows brightly; a gentle sparkle passes along it.

sequences.chapter: Hooray! See you next magic moment!
sequences.title: Celebration, recap and goodbye
sequences.music: Joyful theme reprise; rainbow color song (original); calm outro and end-screen loop

shots.name: Dance party
shots.start_frame: Mipo, the bunny, the baby deer, the blue bird and a happy Little Purple dancing on the hilltop under the full rainbow; confetti sparkles.
shots.motion: Everyone dances gently: the bunny hops, the deer bounces, the bird loops, Mipo spins with his wand.
lines: Hooray for Mipo and his friends!
sfx: joyful celebration sparkle flourish with happy bird tweets

shots.name: Rainbow color song
shots.camera: Medium shot, Mipo pointing to each stripe.
shots.start_frame: Mipo stands under the full rainbow pointing up at the stripes, friends beside him.
shots.motion: Mipo points to each stripe in order as it glows: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple.
lines: Red, orange, yellow, green, blue... and purple!
sing-song, one color per beat, slow

shots.name: What we learned
shots.camera: Medium close-up of Mipo talking to camera.
shots.start_frame: Mipo sits on the grass facing the camera, Little Purple on his shoulder, friends behind.
shots.motion: Mipo talks warmly to the viewer, counting the feelings on his fingers.
lines: Today I felt sad, then brave, then happy! And my friends helped me.

shots.name: Remember
shots.start_frame: The friends sitting together on the hill watching the rainbow, golden light.
shots.motion: Gentle breeze, flowers sway, everyone leans together happily.
lines: Remember: it's okay to feel sad, friends help each other, and every color is important.

shots.name: Goodbye wave
shots.camera: Medium shot, Mipo looks straight at camera.
shots.start_frame: Mipo stands facing the camera under the rainbow, holding the wand up in his left hand, friends around him, top area of the frame clear for text.
shots.motion: Mipo waves at the viewer with his right hand and smiles; friends wave too.
lines: Thank you for helping me, friends! See you next magic moment!

shots.name: End screen
shots.camera: Static wide shot with clear space on the right and top (for YouTube end-screen elements added in YouTube Studio).
